~~~{=html}
<div class="scatter-lab" data-single-scatterer
     role="group" aria-label="Plane wave and the divergent wave from a single scatterer">
  <canvas width="880" height="660" role="img"
          aria-label="A plane wave travelling from left to right is incident on a point scatterer at the center, from which circular waves spread out"></canvas>
  <div class="scatter-lab__buttons" role="group" aria-label="What to show">
    <button type="button" data-mode="incident" aria-pressed="false">Incident</button>
    <button type="button" data-mode="scattered" aria-pressed="false">Scattered</button>
    <button type="button" data-mode="sum" aria-pressed="true">Sum</button>
    <button type="button" data-play>Pause</button>
  </div>
  <label class="scatter-lab__slider">Scattering amplitude, |f|/λ
    <span data-f-value>1.0</span>
    <input type="range" data-f min="0.2" max="2" step="0.1" value="1">
  </label>
</div>
~~~
